stem:
Read these sentences from paragraph 5.

_It is often hard for designers to come up with shapes and styles that have not been made already. But a new kind of fabric can bring something fresh to their work._

What is the best paraphrase of these sentences?

options.label: A
options.text: Having new fabrics to choose from can help designers solve the difficult task of thinking of original ideas for clothing.

options.label: B
options.text: Designers can have a difficult time figuring out how to make interesting styles with new fabrics.

options.label: C
options.text: It can be challenging for designers to make new fabrics work with their current styles.

options.label: D
options.text: Using different fabrics can help designers with the challenging task of making their old clothing look new again.
